A transparent storage block that absorbs dropped items within its space. Adjacent blocks of the same kind form one shared storage network.
An independent filtered storage network. Insert a Create filter and the whole connected sorting network follows its rules.
jei.create_void.entity_myriad.info.1: A transparent 1x1 storage block with no collision; players and dropped items pass through.
jei.create_void.entity_myriad.info.2: Dropped items inside its space are absorbed automatically. Each block stores one item ID; different NBT data is kept separate.
jei.create_void.entity_myriad.info.3: Adjacent blocks of the same kind form one network.
jei.create_void.entity_myriad.info.4: Contents can be processed by fans (splashing, smoking, blasting, haunting) or by a mechanical press above; connected blocks process in parallel.
jei.create_void.entity_myriad.info.5: Outputs return to the network: same-ID blocks first, otherwise an empty slot. Finished products are not processed again and become normal items once extracted.
jei.create_void.entity_myriad.info.6: Can be dismantled quickly with a wrench.
jei.create_void.entity_myriad_sorting.in: The sorting variant of Entity Myriad. It has all the features of Entity Myriad, but the two kinds are independent.
Right-click with a Create filter to insert it (an existing filter is swapped out and returned); right-click empty-handed to retrieve it.
Multiple filters are combined as a union: matching any one of them is enough. With no filter, everything is accepted.
Filters affect ground absorption, pipe/funnel insertion and processed-output placement, but never extraction.
